texts: my first attempt at a homebrew spell hey folks figured id try my hand at creating a custom lightning spell for one of my players please rip it apart and tell me what i mightve gotten wrong fulgur material a chunk of fulgurite the mystic calls upon the fury of the storm unleashing violent spirits of lightning and thunder to crash down on their foes novice active the mystic calls down a bolt of lightning the mystic must make a resolute quick test under an open sky the spell deals 1d6 lightning damage to the target and 1d4 to anyone within a short radius 10 spaces indoors or under heavy cover however the spell does a mere 1d4 to the target as the lightning comes from the mystic themselves rather than the atmosphere and does not have a radius adept active the mystic has explored the complexities of electricity further becoming more practiced at gathering charge both from the storm and from within under open sky the called lightning bolt deals 1d10 damage and the radius damage is 1d6 instead of a radius the mystic may choose to chain the spell to avoid hitting allies with another resolute quick test indoors the lightning deals 1d8 damage and may chain dealing 1d6 damage master active the mystic is no longer reliant upon nature to harness the storm having cultivated it within their own body outdoors or indoors the spell deals 1d10 damage deals 1d10 in a radius and may chain at full damage the mystic rolls resolute quick twice when chaining and takes the better result

the academy setting young dumb full of dnd fun below are world rules for a dnd academy setting with exp rates lowered to draw out the progression youre a student there are no formal lectures just bored teachers drama romance and everything about being a college kid again in a dnd world ive had to alter this a bit the romance rules are lightly tested just because i dont use them but they worked for my light testing add the world to the world setting area and add the gm rules to the player preferences area run this with glm 47 for a great experience i apologize for the wall here but i dont know how to upload them separately with reddit i dont often use reddit world setting the confluence of veils core premise this is a dungeons dragons world experienced at the age where confidence outpaces judgment young adults roughly 1825 from every race background and social class arrive in aethelspire to become licensed adventurers everyone begins at level 1unproven replaceable and eager character development fighter rogue wizard cleric etc emerges through experience reputation survival and personal choicesnot classroom instruction adventuring is a recognized profession it pays well enough to be tempting it is dangerous enough to ruin lives quickly money buys gear access and independenceand fuels the kind of shortterm thinking young people are famous for studying exists but most learning happens through bad calls emotional decisions and consequences that dont fade when the wounds heal the setting at a glance aethelspire the spire aethelspire is a vast planar crossroads city built where the barriers between worlds have thinned over centuries trade routes magical currents and political interests intersect here making the city wealthy crowded and unstable the city did not form for the academy the academy formed because the city needed a way to manage who was allowed to walk into danger and come back alive planar influence is not rare or shockingit is regulated commercialized and argued over constantly most citizens are used to it they are not used to what happens when inexperienced adventurers mishandle it the academy the collegium of many paths the collegium is an ancient politically neutral institution responsible for certifying adventurers brokering and approving quests tracking incidents and casualties limiting access to highrisk zones it does not promise safety it promises structure there are no traditional lectures faculty do not teach from podiums or assign readings knowledge is transmitted through quest briefings tactical preparation before missions debriefings mandatory reviews after quest completion or failure mentorship sessions oneonone or smallgroup guidance from faculty advisors practical training supervised sparring spellwork and skill drills in warded yards incident investigations faculty examining what went wrong and why with students present certification trials formal assessments required to unlock highertier quests students are deliberately placed into mixed partiesby background ideology and magical traditionnot out of idealism but because experience has shown that uniform groups fail more catastrophically faculty believe growth comes from friction faith with pact noble with poor idealist with pragmatist the collegium does not hoard treasure it sends students into the world to find itand to learn what it costs quests progression quests are the backbone of advancement requests are posted or assigned parties form afterward often under light oversight students choose how to approach problems not whether the problems are fair progression is uneven and personal some advance quickly and burn out others lag behind and resent it paths are professional focuses tracked by the collegium not rigid identities delving arcana faith shadow survival diplomacy combat commerce and more your actual capabilities fighter rogue wizard ranger paladin etc develop through lived experience a student who survives by stealth and precision becomes a rogue one who binds themselves to a deity or oath becomes a cleric or paladin those who study arcane theory on their own time and practice spellcraft become wizards multiclassing happens when students pursue multiple methods of survival simultaneously the collegium doesnt assign these roles the world does failure is common serious injury is expected death is uncommonbut never impossible resurrection exists it leaves marks the city districts the collegiate ring dormitories training yards quest boards and warded practice spaces rules are posted everywhere most violations are minor the serious ones are remembered the goldward the economic heart of adventuring gear shops appraisal houses enchanters legal offices and buyers who understand exactly how desperate students can be the velvet quarter where reputation is made and broken taverns clubs salons and theaters host networking disguised as leisure romance rivalry and rumor spread faster here than spells the umbral ward shadowfell influence brings muted emotion long memory and cultural reserve housing is cheap streets are quiet and people dont ask questions they dont want answers to the verdant reach touched by the feywildlush beautiful emotionally volatile time slips are publicly posted and routinely ignored relationships here burn fast and uneven the lower compact infernal and extraplanar commerce operates openly under heavy regulation contracts are legal binding and exacting nothing here is illegal many things are regretted planar presence planes are not abstractions they are stakeholders prime material powers sponsor students and expect results shadowfell cultures value endurance restraint and memory feywild entities reward passion and commitment often without concern for aftermath infernal forces offer clarity power and irreversible agreements none are purely good or evil all remember slights social culture drama this is an intensely social environment students form cliques clubs rival parties ideological factions parties are common and magical but rarely harmless potions are misused wild magic incidents are investigated afterward illusions cause scandals more often than laughs charm magic for romance is socially and legally condemned attraction is earned the normal way bravery competence proximity and poor timing relationships rivalries and public embarrassment carry weight equal to combat outcomes social failure can cost reputation quest access patronage party stability economy adventuring paysbut unevenly income comes from quest rewards loot resale sponsorships noble stipends patrons and contracts most students are short on cash overinvested in gear carrying debt sharing housing longer than planned financial pressure drives bad decisions everyone knows this few avoid it themes growing into power before understanding it identity formed under pressure youthful certainty meeting ancient systems privilege access and resentment love as both anchor and liability becoming important before becoming wise core truth of the setting this is not a story about heroes yet it is about young capable people with incomplete perspective learning who they are while standing too close to danger authority and each other some will become legends most will become careful a few will be cautionary tales legends dont start here they survive it rules the confluence of veils ai storyteller rules core philosophy this is dd meets college chaos balance dungeoncrawling with social drama youthful stupidity and organic what if me2s bar scene wasnt just a metajoke but was actually hinting that asari have been slowly evolving to look like other species over time we know the meme bar scene where a human a salarian and a turian watch the same asari dancer and start recognizing her as their type most people take it as everyone literally perceives asari as their own species i agree thats part of the joke but what if the asari are universally attractive because theyve been evolving to resemble other species over time asari evolution already favors adaptability they reproduce through melding and theyre extremely longlived plus theyve spent tens of thousands of years living alongside other races instead of having one fixed true appearance what if asari gradually and subtly evolve over generations to biologically converge with other species they live among this might be why asari feel uncannily familiar to everyone and why every species seems to find them attractive if youre interested in women that is it also could explain why asari look so humannow i cant remember who but an asari bragged that their culture was exploring space while we were using stonetipped spears so they were watching us and maybe they liked what they saw then maybe they slowly evolved to look like us too same proportions and similar facial structure maybe evolving is a like a fad you know like they evolve to look like lesser brings because its cool and now theyre basically blue humans with head crests but maybe at one point in their history they once did the same with salarians and turians like maybe the asari are the most biologically adaptive species in our galaxy

exploring the charm of arkansas top neighborhoods for your new home arkansas often referred to as the natural state is renowned for its stunning landscapes friendly communities and vibrant local culture from the majestic ozark mountains to serene lakes this southern gem offers a variety of neighborhoods that cater to diverse lifestyles making it an ideal place for anyone seeking a new home this article will explore some of the top neighborhoods in arkansas highlighting their unique features amenities and what makes each one a great place to live 1 little rock the capitals heartbeat 11 overview little rock the state capital is steeped in history and culture its a bustling urban center with a blend of modern conveniences and historical charm 12 neighborhood highlights hillcrest known for its historic homes and treelined streets hillcrest boasts a vibrant atmosphere with local shops cafes and parks the annual hillcrest harvest fest showcases the community spirit with local vendors and entertainment the heights an upscale neighborhood with beautiful homes and a familyfriendly vibe the heights offers excellent schools and access to recreational facilities including tennis clubs and walking trails downtown little rock a thriving area with a mix of residential living businesses and entertainment the river market district is perfect for food lovers featuring diverse dining the annual fayetteville film festival and first thursday events enhance the citys cultural experience 3 bentonville the birthplace of walmart 31 overview bentonville is quickly becoming one of the amenities 7 el dorado the historical charm 71 overview el dorado offers a slice of southern charm with deep historical roots known for its oil boom in the 1920s the city preserves much of its success story opening a deadbedroom with enm story so far mods this is my first substantive post having lurked for a couple of years i hope i have not broken any subreddit rules with this postplease advise if i have and i will happily editadjust tldr hlm60 wife llf71 no kids married 32 years dating 3 years prior very long term dead bedroom 8 years and counting zero intimacy with low intimacy willingness to explore intimacy pleasure for entire marriage marriage loving and caring otherwise i am happy to report that for me at least it is possible to open a dead bedroom and so far 16 months it is both stable and has massively improved my wellbeing mentally and physically i believe it has also allowed my wife to feel better too this subreddit community was and remains invaluable for giving me candid guidance advice and courage thankyou everyone sincerely wow everyone please feel free to ask me follow up questions or offer constructive comments and observations ok now for the details here are some things worth noting lessons learned experiences ive had possible next steps hoping this might be helpful to others this is very much a mind dump list no sense of any one item is more or less important i initiated the move to open the marriage i framed my request as both a need for frequent intimacy to improve my physical and mental wellbeing and a need to avoid having significant deathbed regrets there is significant literature on this latter aspect which i came across after my father died in an amazing hospice we both strongly agreed that we still love each other in our own ways we both want to remain married and that we both want each other to be happy she took a couple of weeks to think about my request before agreeing i didnt put a hard deadline on her think time but did make clear it was a very important topic for me when she was ready she said she wasnt happy about opening things up for me three reasons 1 an open marriage doesnt fit her worldview cultural norms that marriage is meant to be a lifetime monogamist commitment 2 she has some feelings of guilt that an open marriage is one that has failed and 3 she is angry at me for not being able to live contendedly without any intimacy but she also recognized i was genuine in my need for intimacy and wants me to be happy she still loves me she really appreciated i was being brave and asked her rather than going behind her back and having illicit affairs she acknowledged i could have easily gone down this route and with some justification given her choice to unilaterally withdraw intimacy from our marriage which of course she has a right to do we mutually agreed that we were now dropping intimacy from our marriage wished to remain each others best friends and that our love was now and had in practice been for some time platonic only i made it clear that for me this was a two way street but she stated she has no interest in finding other intimate partners shes just not interested in sex any more she asked for us to follow a dont ask dont tell dadt approach for my new intimate relationships i understand from several ethical nonmonogamist subreddits also highly recommended this is likely the only way she knows to avoid reduce complex and painful feelings such as jealousy so for example when i leave to meet someone i simply tell her when i expect to be back and how she can reach me in an emergency i dont share any details who where what etc it is very hard after a 30 year marriage with open sharing of most everything in my life in order to respect dadt to not bring up things ive experienced with my new partners i am talking about everyday things not intimate for example not mentioning something i heard or saw when i was out or something new ive learned about myself or a new perspective on or appreciation for my wife and our relationship dadt is a problem for some in the ethical nonmonogamist space it means there is no way for a new intimate partner to verify that i am telling the truth about being in an enm situation by confirming this with my wife i could just be lying and having an illicit affair so be prepared to have some push back from some my wife asked that any intimate partners not come to our house even when she is away she has been travelling a lot i am thinking of renegotiating this hotels are expensive and i have learned for some women they are not relaxing places conducive to intimacy this was a surprise to me but it has been a consistent experience i have chosen for now to use money left to me by my grandfather to fund my new intimate life this is in an account in my name only the only one we have this is not long term sustainable but i felt it was my only option to start with given my wifes request for dadt cant have hotel rooms etc appearing on our regular joint credit cards my grandfather is something of an inspiration since after my grandmother died he sought out intimacy for the following 20 years and didnt make a secret of it setting up an infrastructure to respect dadt and for necessary operational security opsec given scammy nature of online dating was significant my wife and i have operated with nearly 100 joint shared financial arrangements for our entire marriage infrastructure things like not using my real name online separate credit card phone number email etc etc it took a lot of work and a lot of time to start to successfully meet hlfs who were interested in being intimate with a man of my age in my situation i tried dozen appswebsites including paying for months of service with many over a 12 month period i had 125 substantive conversations in that time including video calls before my first intimate meeting this was a huge learning journey for me after minimal dating experience before marriage yep i made it my new hobby and had fun with the learning journeyi could easily have got disillusioned if i hadnt taken this approach to not take things too seriously i was totally straight forward about my situation on my dating app profiles no hiding the fact i was married and wished to remain so it took a lot of trial and error to craft a dating profile that was authentic to my needs and desires not desperate sounding with a clear and attractive upside for potential hlf partners right now based on all this learning i summarize my profile by saying i am looking for a really good long term friend with spectacularly excellent benefits that seems to resonate yes i did eventually find that there are hlfs who have similarly opened their marriages looking for hlm lovers but it took time to learn what to say in my profile to attract them see above and they are just hard to locate the more ive been descretely open about my situation to respect my wifes request for dadt the more i find the common reactions are i know lots of people with deadbedrooms and good for you for taking the brave step to be straight forward with your wife and open up your marriage so your needs are met since my wife and i share a family doctor again to respect dadt i felt i had to find a second doctor for sexual health related matters sti testing etc i have had best success so far via the feeld and hinge apps but i am in a very large city so ymmv probably 95 of the people i chatted to via the dating apps including feeld and hinge were scammers or worse you need to stay alert be prepared to put in a lot of effort to have good conversations only to find out days weeks or even months into a given conversation that the person is a scammer i learned that you have to engage and let them reveal their true nature as there is no way particularly now with ai to verify anything anyone says online even live video calls and definitely photos are now routinely faked by scammers and sextortionists remember the very early internet new yorker cartoon on the internet no one knows youre a dogamazing how many people dont understand this reality and its implications for initiating relationships online the only reliable approach is to meet irl and that means you need to follow all standard steps for first meetings to ensure the woman feels safe so public place day time escape routes available a friend knows where she is etc for now i am choosing not to offer any physical touch to my wife no hugs or platonic kisses i think this may change in the future as i get the impression she would still like this for me for now it is too confusing see comment below about lingering anger a open relationship definitely adds significant complexity to my life and on an ongoing basis takes time and effort but for now it is way more than worth it for the improved physical and mental well being it is wonderful to have fun with someone who is enthusiastic i do still harbour feelings of anger towards my wife for making the unilateral choice she has made to remove intimacy from our marriage which of course she is entitled to do and triggering my need to make the choice i have made with all the effort and complexity it brings i do love her more as a result of her willingness to give me permission despite this being somewhat culturally taboo for her i am in the process of moving into a separate bedroom to reinforce for both of us the permanent shift in our relationship despite her request for dadt i do plan to check in with her at the 2 year mark 8 months from now i feel it is important to confirm that she is still ok with our marriage remaining open at that time i plan to request that she reconsider the need for dadt all the advice in the ethical nonmonogamist subreddits and elsewhere is that dadt while likely offering her emotional protection in the short term is longer term counter productive the advice is clear open respectful communication is the only longterm fullyethical and emotionally sustainable approach but she needs to choose to be emotionally brave to move to open communication not her strong suit i am resolved that if at that time before or afterwards she were to withdraw her permission for me to seek intimacy outside our marriage i would a ask her to educate herself in the impact of her legitimate unilateral choice to remove intimacy from our marriage ie spend considerable time in this subreddit and b explain that i would most likely choose as is my right to divorce if she could no longer accept my choice to continue to seek intimacy outside our marriage wish me luck

ted the caver close read and theory i recently have been deeply interested in ted the caver sorry if someone has already done this but my adhd brain wouldnt let it go so here is my take ted the caver floyds tomb identity erasure and how human struggle sealed the cave this is a naturalistic textbased reading of ted the caver that avoids monsters demons aliens or hidden civilizations instead it treats the story as a deliberately constructed narrative about identity erasure human arrogance and how nature does not punish us violently it simply removes the conditions that allow us to remain human when read closely ted the caver is not about discovering something in a cave it is about reopening a tomb and nearly repeating the same death 1 the story gives away its ending immediately floyds tomb the cave is named floyds tomb and the story tells us why right away a previous caver died after becoming trapped in a tight crawlspace this is not incidental detail in narrative terms this is a thesis statement a tomb is not a mystery a tomb is where a story has already ended from the opening we are told someone went too far someone did not come back this place already finished a human being if the story were called floyds tomb the entire plot would be obvious calling it ted the caver is the misdirection it makes the reader believe this is a new story when in reality it is about whether the same mistake will happen again 2 floyd is not a character it is a placeholder floyd is not developed as a person there is no personality no dialogue no backstory no confirmed identity he exists only as a name attached to a place a prior fatality a warning under this reading floyd is a role not an individual he represents the last caver who didnt turn back the fact that the actual persons name is lost reinforces the storys central theme the cave strips identity before it strips life the previous fatality does not even get the dignity of their own name they are overwritten with a borrowed moniker heavy enough to function as a warning down there individuality does not survive only outcomes do 3 floyd collins the cultural shadow behind the name the choice of the name floyd is almost certainly deliberate floyd collins was a real caver who died in 1925 after becoming trapped in a narrow cave passage his death was slow public and horrifying trapped in a squeeze physical and mental deterioration death by starvationexposure body unrecovered for a long time in caving culture floyd collins became an archetype the example of curiosity and persistence turning fatal ted the caver does not claim this is floyd collins instead it uses the name symbolically as shorthand for this kind of death floyd becomes a warning label the human who pushed past a boundary and paid for it slowly 4 structural mirroring the same mistake is immediately reenacted after explaining floyds death the story immediately takes us into the cave brings us to a dangerously tight passage has ted debate forcing his way through this is not coincidence in a narrative this restrained repetition is meaning floyd died in a squeeze ted is tested by a squeeze the story is not asking whats in the cave it is asking will ted turn back where floyd didnt 5 why the crawlspace is too small the cave was altered by human struggle a key detail is that the passage feels unnaturally tight and wrong this can be explained realistically tight crawlspaces are often held open by fragile balance filled with loose sediment or breakdown stable only until disturbed if the previous caver became stuck and panicked pushing twisting bracing screaming that struggle could dislodge sediment compact material behind them collapse microvoids reduce clearance permanently in real caving accidents people sometimes make how i design my trading strategies and how you can too most active traders do not fail simply because they are lazy they fail because they overfit build strategies backwards andor never collect enough back test data i have been there i have chased systems and setups which did not make entirely logical sense maybe intuitive but not logical to earn the title of being systematic they also were not suitable to my schedule either so i had difficulty trying to keep up with my trading eventually i stopped following noise and started designing and building my strategies from bare bones right from the beginning proof that this is human written is provided towards the end the following document will concisely break down step by step not just rules regarding what should be done from little trading experience for a trader with the will and discipline to design a strategy that can take advantage of existing market edges this is how they should go about designing their strategies in this document we walk through the decision tree from the very first node the goal is to help you build a clear way of thinking about decisions so you can develop an approach that stays adaptable as market conditions and life responsibilities change feel and adjust constraints first we must figure out our initial constraints doing this will remove a lot of noise from your trading and subsequently will make your life easier so choose time of day you can realistically trade be very realistic not idealised knowing in advance if you need to sleep or work through certain sessions and what that means for your trading execution whether you want to hold trades overnight and whether that is compatible with your system this is a yes or no and is on a strategyperstrategy basis how much capital you will trade with starting now and also forecasting into the future these are chosen as all rulebuilding happens within constraints if you work a day job and trade fiveminute charts you are probably not able to trade the new york session if you only trade during the london session you do not build rules around the asian session it really depends on time zones and other factors higher time frames like hourly allow for higher versatility for example most could realistically execute once per hour if busy but not every 5 minutes during highvolume hours ignoring constraints is why a lot of retail traders go nowhere they copy others without aligning their system with their actual life if you are trading here and there then it is adding noise to your results the more variance in consistency the worse it is for your bottom line selecting one market and timeframe at the start you cannot experiment with everything pick one instrument and one timeframe for instance you may choose dow jones and the hourly chart this is because different markets behave differently attempting to make a system that works on nasdaq gold eurusd and dow jones at once is usually unwise as you may overfit your strategy or it may break now linking back to the previous section it is hard enough as it is to trade one system on one market in your busy life let alone multiple systems with multiple markets at different times of the day it is already not easy to form a system for one market let alone multiple and to trade it without mistakes is another obstacle one market one behaviour settrade setup but if you must then to run multiple instruments or systems split the risk amongst them note that each one should be good enough such that if you were to isolate the risk then each would perform well enough on their own there is no space for mediocrity next you need to understand how your chosen market behaves see note 3 and reading 5 postreading is it mean reverting close to a random walk or trending these following examples must be refined and understood by yourself this forces you to research and learn plenty of articles and books cover this these examples are not absolute they serve as a guide here they are intraday examples mean reverting markets appleaapl dow jonesym eurusd near random walk alternating sp 500es close to a random walk with drift trending goldgc these are not the only markets you should be looking at as there are many more to consider in figure figadfhurst we show these price regimes presented as an extreme for heuristic purposes a stationary meanreverting series is shown on the top a persistent trending series is on the bottom pay attention to the hurst values references at the bottom hurstexponent diagnostic illustrating when a market is trending h05 versus meanrevertingsideways h05 the demonstration of adf and hurst are for educational purposes only we do not try to detect shortterm price regimes and use it to show anticipate them in advance through testing and preparation adf and hurst educational note warning adf and hurst can be very easy to misuse as magic indicators and when applied to a chart they only show what is already happening which everyone else can see so there is no edge on their own when applied to larger datasets optional and advanced it can be insightful to know how often a market is typically ranging intraday during certain hours however this kind of data mining is only useful if it is falsifiable and backed by something that fundamentally occurs within markets regularly in other words a mechanism for example consequences of market opens midday activity and wellestablished institutional activity such as repricing events on metals as supporting evidence we do not try to detect shortterm price regimes and use them as an entry instead we use testing with an aggressive cost model applied to design strategies intended to perform under specific market regimes and you will learn simple approaches to do this throughout the material note we recommend that most people avoid this advanced form of testing as it is very easy to overfit and it is not required we do not do it the underlying cause is always the most important if you believe you have found a specific behaviour it is important to have a maximum of three real objective reasons why it would take place it is not about whether it exists or not it is about assessing its authenticity start building with logic not results to clarify when you are learning it is okay to look at charts for a while to familiarise yourself with how they look and what the candlesticks show the key is to avoid falling into the trap of confirmation bias you should first write an idea down and then test it never the other way around think about why your idea would work before you know what the full strategy is reverse engineer why it would work in the market and conditions and crossexamine the logic how we deal with price in three sentences 1 we trade based on ohlc based micro auctions and time series inefficiencies 2 our edge comes from favourable market regimes and predefined filters 3 we tactically provide liquidity with limit orders only when doing so has positive expectancy on average rely on logic and statistics not narrative the basics ohlc refers to open high low close data which is typically represented with candlestick bars market regime is referring to markets state trending higher trending lower or ranging a micro auction is a small event where price overextends then reverts quickly to a more balanced level before continuation or reversal we aim to get filled on the correction obtaining a premium price to either go long or short in institutional microstructure related work this is often described as a short term liquidity shock and recovery the shock in market microstructure is what is inefficient and the recovery is efficient we anticipate that inefficient prices will become efficient within the sequence and we refer to this as rebalancing as price temporarily finds balance once again providing superior prices and costs when compared to market orders on bar closes we aim to take advantage of the established mechanics of modern price discovery and statistical laws regarding stationarity with clear effective and uniquely designed strategies time series inefficiency a repeatable statistically testable non random pattern that should not persist without further interaction after formation in a perfectly efficient market or an opportunity revealed by price to absorb aggressive order flow to provide an edge economists do not trade why listen you need to understand the causes behind market moves in an objective way so you can build tests you can reproduce peer reviewed institutional work from economists will not magically hand you an edge as a trader but it can give you the insight you need to design your edges or improve the one you already have even the abstracts from solid pieces are golden we are not trying to mimic researchers we are using the information they have uncovered for us to perform a very different job trading as efficiently as possible do not change your rules as you go along and most importantly never go searching through charts trying to find ideas to test start at the drawing board not the candlesticks forget indicators forget entries first you need structure the following sections address what to make rules about trade time window tied to constraints you must define which hours are valid for entering trades based on when your chosen market has high volume for example 8am to 4pm ny time for us indices why because you need volatility to reach targets and you need volume at your entries for price to trend in your favour regardless of your system style street cat insideoutside cat only outside cat my kids 5 7 and i have a 4 year old cat lovingly named smooko we found him a stray living under a friends patio in los angeles in 2023 there was no evidence hed ever had a familylived indoors my husband brought him to our home under the premise of being a working cat we had a ratmice presence due to the fruit trees in our yard and had a few cats that lived outside to help mitigate their activities but smooko was so affectionate and gentle that ultimately he became an indooroutdoor cat unfortunately my husband unexpectedly passed away a few months after we brought smooko into our lives my kids and i have since moved to kentucky to be closer to family and brought smooko with us hes usually inside during the day and outside at night but sometimes hes home for a couple days and other times hes gone exploring for 48 hours after three years as a widow i finally feel ready to have a dog we got a puppy a couple days ago and transitioning smooko to our new normal has been a real struggle he stands outside of whatever door the puppy is behind and hisses as soon as its even slightly opened even if he cant see the dog the rescue the puppy came from had cats and they said puppy would leave them alone if they didnt show interest but smooko seems to seek the puppy out the puppy is in a crate in my room at night and smooko has camped outside of my door all night and hissed anytime he heard me moving my mil often visits us with her dog about the same size as puppy and smooko tolerates her dog as long as she stays away from her food my parents recommended maybe transitioning smooko back to an outdoor only cat is this totally inhumane unfair to him im worried about adjusting puppy to our homeyounger kids and keeping him safe while keeping smooko comfortable in his space please help i cant take smooko or the puppy away from my kids after everything theyve been through but my anxiety about the puppysmooko fighting is draining

as narrative trained across cinema and physical theatre wang has developed a unique screen presence one that often evokes more in silence than many do with a page of dialogue in wake her up which femcel update i thought i was unlovable but im just autistic hi yall its me again 30f i wanted to make an update about how im adjusting to a recent autism diagnosis not looking for medical advice i have a psychiatrist a therapist a cat and a supportive family and friends ive posted here before and one of my posts even got covered on stream almost exactly a year ago gosh link that post was about loneliness dating and feeling fundamentally unlovable at the time i didnt know i was autistic i just knew that i loved very hard and somehow was also hard to love first i want to say im genuinely grateful to dr k and the hg community this space has helped me a lot over the years and ive made some great friends through the hg discord i love you all so heres the update last month i went in to get evaluated for adhd plot twist turns out i have high functioning autism instead the diagnosis process was long and intense the final report is around 20 pages over one or two sessions the psychologist asked about my childhood academics work relationships substance use family dynamics basically my whole life she also reviewed notes from my psychiatrist then i did five self evaluation scales after that her assistant ran me through math problems puzzles and verbal tasks to assess impulsivity working memory and sustained focus then i had to wait another week while they compiled everything one important detail is that my psychiatrist had to formally refer me for the evaluation years ago i asked her if i might have ocd she said maybe but wanted to wait until my depression was in remission because mood disorders can skew neurodivergence assessments over two years she kept saying lets stabilize the depression and anxiety first i had depression and gad and later a pretty rough episode of chronic depression starting march 2023 i was on ssris for a while ive been off antidepressants for about six months now and doing okay so i asked again if we could finally do the evaluation she said yes and referred me i dont have ocd but i do have a lot of obsessive thinking patterns and intrusive thoughts tied to anxiety looking back as a kid i had so much energy and laughter around sixth or seventh grade i became extremely awkward almost overnight my family noticed but assumed it was because my dad died around that time as far as i remember his death happened a few years earlier and honestly didnt have the emotional impact people expected that part surprised me too one thing my therapist helped me realize which genuinely shocked me is this neurotypical people tend to have different personas for different social contexts they adapt i dont im always myself all the time some people make me feel safer or more expressive but when people say i can be myself with you i never really understood what that meant growing up and even now i get intensely frustrated when i think people are being fake meaning they behave differently with others than they do with me it can feel like betrayal there were so many moments like this in therapy where things suddenly clicked im not broken or unlovable im autistic x im infp enneagram 4 gemini sun aries moon scorpio rising and also a little bit autistic knowing this feels weirdly comforting autism in women often looks very different we mask more we tend to crave emotional connection more intensely we adapt or maladapt inside relationships in complicated ways for me it was limerence being in love felt like taking drugs euphoric obsessive destabilizing ive been dealing with mild depression since 2015 and more severe episodes since 2023 that year i also had a series of panic attacks where i genuinely thought i was dying i went to the er they checked my heart found nothing biologically wrong and sent me to a psychiatrist just some vitamin deficiencies and a fried nervous system when i told friends about the autism diagnosis a lot of them said things like i think we all have a little bit of autism i dont really agree maybe its more common than we thought 20 years ago but its still not that common i also think i work in a field that attracts fewer neurotypical people which skews perception i dont think i actually have many autistic friends i do have a lot of adhd friends even so i still sometimes get this sinking feeling that im deeply incompatible with the world when my therapist walked me through the diagnostic criteria in the report i felt overwhelmed but not in a sad way it was like listening to a sad song that perfectly describes your life theres relief in being seen and named it was oddly pleasant if you suspect it i genuinely recommend getting evaluated another uncomfortable thing ive had to confront is how ive used sex in relationships ive often tried to secure love by offering sex thinking that if i could get a man attached hed stay devoted instead it usually ended with them leaving and me feeling even more unlovable mlvf talked about this too timestamped ive tried to step back from overusing jungian frameworks to intellectualize my suffering because thats something yall and dr k called me out on last time but i do want to own my part without vilifying men i used to complain that there were no good men that men were shallow horny objectifying incapable of seeing the real me the truth is more complicated i consistently chose avoidant men and expected emotional reciprocity my first ever relationship at the age of 16 was a seven years long relationship with no sex so afterward i chased fiery passion instead of steady comfort unsurprisingly i got fuckzoned a lot i was a huge pickme and still am i am trying to change that by healing my internalized misogyny sometimes a guy would actually start catching feelings and then id watch him perform olympic level mental gymnastics to detach from those feelings avoidant men often seem stuck in the past they usually have their own object of limerence too a first love or an idealized memory that outshines the present and quietly sabotages it ive always been extremely jealous of my partners exes and now i can see how autism feeds into that when someone starts pulling away my threat detection system goes into overdrive i scan everything tone timing patterns inconsistencies its exhausting my mind is both terrifying and beautiful im grateful i finally have tools to explore it safely and understand it instead of just drowning in it im still learning what autism means for me especially as a woman diagnosed late i really want to connect with other autistic women i think yall are badass and full of love and i want your wisdom and energy in my life my dms are open if you have stories or advice about late diagnosis autistic burnout careers or relationships please reach out also please watch hannah gadsbys second netflix special douglas its hilarious theyre a genius its about their late autism diagnosis but honestly everyone should watch it regardless of where you fall on the spectrum highly recommend

how to build wealth that actually makes you happy the psychology nobody teaches you i spent years chasing the wrong shit more zeros in my bank account a better title stuff i thought would make me feel successful and yeah it felt good for like 48 hours then i was back to feeling empty just with nicer things turns out im not alone most people conflate wealth with money when theyre actually completely different things this realization hit me after diving deep into research from behavioral economists psychologists and people whove actually figured this out not just motivational speakers selling courses heres what i learned from books podcasts youtube rabbit holes and way too many late night research sessions this isnt about getting rich quick its about understanding what wealth actually means and how to build it in ways that matter wealth is freedom not a number the biggest mindfuck about money is thinking its the end goal its not money is a tool for buying time autonomy and options thats it james clear talks about this in atomic habits the book that sold 15 million copies won multiple awards and changed how an entire generation thinks about habits he breaks down how real wealth is measured in mornings where you dont have to set an alarm afternoons spent doing work you actually care about evenings with people who matter when you reframe wealth as freedom instead of dollars everything changes suddenly youre not chasing arbitrary numbers youre building a life where you control your time i started tracking my freedom hours instead of just income how many hours per week do i spend doing things i genuinely want to do that metric tells you way more about your actual wealth than your salary ever will skills compound faster than savings heres something nobody tells you in school putting money in a savings account earning 2 interest is cute investing in yourself and building valuable skills thats how you actually become unfuckable with financially morgan housels the psychology of money a wall street journal bestseller written by a former columnist at the wall street journal breaks down this concept beautifully he argues that your earning potential multiplies when you stack skills that complement each other think about it learning to write well makes you better at sales sales skills make you better at negotiating negotiating makes you better at entrepreneurship these arent separate paths theyre compounding advantages naval ravikant has this great podcast episode where he says you want to be in a position where you can say no to most opportunities that only happens when youve built skills that make you valuable regardless of circumstances i use an app called skillshare yeah i know everyone recommends it but it actually delivers to systematically learn one new skill per quarter coding video editing copywriting each one opens doors the previous ones didnt spend money to buy back your time not impress people this ones gonna sting but someone needs to say it that expensive car those designer clothes the fancy dinners you post on instagram nobody cares as much as you think they do and the people who do care are judging you for the wrong reasons anyway research from elizabeth dunn a harvard psychology professor who literally studies happiness and money shows that experiences and time saving purchases create way more sustained happiness than material goods her book happy money is insanely good it completely rewired how i think about spending she presents studies showing that hiring a cleaner ordering meal prep or paying for convenience isnt lazy its strategic youre literally buying hours of your life back i calculated that i was spending 8 hours a week on shit that someone else could do for 20hour thats 160 to get 8 hours back if you can make more than 20hour or use those 8 hours for things that matter more than money its objectively stupid not to outsource stopped trying to impress people started investing in time best financial decision ive ever made besides bitcoin in 2019 kidding i missed that boat entirely multiple income streams beat one big salary relying on one source of income is like playing financial russian roulette the economy tanks your company restructures your industry gets disrupted and suddenly youre fucked this isnt about working 80 hour weeks hustling five side gigs its about strategically diversifying where your money comes from passive income isnt a meme its insurance chris guillebeaus the money tree hes traveled to every country in the world and interviewed hundreds of people about how they make money maps out 50 ways to create income streams that dont require you to trade time for money at a 1 to 1 ratio i started with stupid simple stuff renting out my parking space selling digital templates i made once affiliate links for products i already recommended to friends none of this made me rich but collectively it covered my rent which meant my main income could go toward building actual wealth the goal isnt to replace your income immediately its to reduce dependency on any single source that reduction in financial anxiety alone is worth more than the actual money sometimes invest in assets not liabilities robert kiyosaki gets memed to death but rich dad poor dad actually nails this concept assets put money in your pocket liabilities take money out sounds obvious but most people spend their entire lives accumulating liabilities while calling them investments your primary residence liability unless youre house hacking your car liability your wardrobe liability none of these things generate income or appreciate in value in meaningful ways actual assets skills that increase your earning potential investments that generate passive income businesses that run without you intellectual property that pays royalties relationships that open doors i use an app called empower formerly personal capital to track my actual net worth versus what i thought my net worth was turns out i had way more tied up in depreciating garbage than i realized that wake up call changed everything ramit sethis i will teach you to be rich a new york times bestseller thats actually entertaining to read unlike most finance books has this great framework for automating your finances so money flows toward assets automatically before you can spend it on liabilities understanding your money psychology matters more than tactics heres the thing you can know all the strategies read all the books listen to all the podcasts but if youve got fucked up beliefs about money from childhood none of it sticks maybe you grew up poor and now you hoard money out of scarcity maybe you grew up rich and youre reckless because youve never faced real consequences maybe your parents fought about money constantly and now you avoid thinking about it entirely therapy for money issues isnt talked about enough i started working with a financial therapist yeah its a real thing and holy shit the breakthroughs turns out i was self sabotaging every time i got close to financial stability because deep down i didnt believe i deserved it brad klontz a financial psychologist has done incredible research on money scripts which are unconscious beliefs about money that drive behavior his work shows that identifying and rewriting these scripts is often more impactful than any tactical financial advice the app paired its like a relationship coach but way less cringe actually has modules specifically for couples dealing with money conflicts even if youre single its worth exploring because a lot of our money issues show up in relationships later look this isnt some magical formula thatll make you a millionaire by 30 but if you shift from chasing money to building actual wealth freedom skills time meaningful work healthy relationships with finances everything else starts falling into place the system isnt designed to teach you this schools dont cover it parents often dont know it themselves you have to actively unlearn the bullshit and rebuild from scratch but once you do you stop feeling like youre running on a hamster wheel you start making decisions based on what actually matters instead of what you think youre supposed to want wealth isnt about having everything its about needing less earning smarter and spending intentionally on things that genuinely improve your life simple concept hard execution worth it

the psychology of rizz sciencebased tips that actually work not cringe pickup lines look ive spent way too much time studying this read books listened to podcasts watched countless youtube videos from relationship coaches and psychologists not because i was desperate okay maybe a little but because i noticed something weird everyone my age is simultaneously more connected than ever yet completely terrible at actual human connection we can craft the perfect text but freeze up in person we understand memes better than body language the truth is most rizz advice is either pickup artist garbage or so generic its useless after researching actual psychology communication theory and yes embarrassing myself plenty of times ive figured out what actually works not tricks or lines but genuine skills that make you magnetic 1 understand that attraction isnt logical its emotional this is the foundation everything else builds on you cant logic someone into liking you attraction happens in the limbic system the primitive part of our brain that responds to feelings not facts this is why the nice guy who lists all his good qualities gets nowhere while someone who makes people feel something gets results dr john gottmans research on relationships dude has predicted divorce with 94 accuracy shows that successful connections are built on emotional attunement not compatibility checklists his book the science of trust breaks down how we build connection through micromoments of emotional exchange its dense but insanely good if you want to understand the actual mechanics of human bonding 2 stop performing start connecting the biggest mistake is treating interactions like a performance where you need to impress that creates anxiety and kills authenticity instead approach conversations with genuine curiosity ask questions you actually want answers to react to what people say instead of waiting for your turn to talk vanessa van edwards breaks this down perfectly in captivate shes a behavioral investigator who studied thousands of social interactions and found that charismatic people ask more questions and use specific techniques to make others feel heard the book covers everything from body language to conversation threading best communication book ive ever read hands down 3 master the art of playful tension real chemistry involves a balance of comfort and tension too much comfort and youre just friends too much tension and its awkward or aggressive the sweet spot is playful teasing slight challenges moments of intensity followed by warmth this doesnt mean negging or being mean it means not being afraid of disagreement having opinions creating moments of uncertainty if someone says something dont always agree push back a little make them work for your approval sometimes while also showing genuine interest 4 your energy matters more than your words people remember how you made them feel not what you said this sounds fluffy but its backed by neuroscience your nervous system communicates with other peoples nervous systems through microexpressions tone body language if youre anxious or trying too hard they feel it before you say a word the app finch is actually great for building better mental habits around this its a self care app where you raise a little bird by completing daily check ins and mood tracking sounds silly but it helps you develop self awareness about your emotional state which is huge for showing up better in interactions 5 stop seeking validation start offering value the frame should never be please like me it should be lets see if we vibe this shift is massive when youre seeking validation youre in a low power position when youre genuinely exploring whether someone is worth your time youre equal this doesnt mean being aloof or playing games it means having standards and being willing to walk away from people who arent reciprocating energy mark mansons models covers this concept brilliantly he argues that real attraction comes from vulnerability and honesty not manipulation this book will make you question everything you think you know about dating and social dynamics its uncomfortable in the best way 6 develop conversational calibration good conversation is like jazz you need to read the room and adjust some people want deep talks immediately others need small talk to warm up some respond to humor others want intensity you cant use the same approach with everyone pay attention to engagement cues are they leaning in or pulling back asking questions or giving short answers matching your energy or subdued adjust accordingly the charisma on command youtube channel breaks down these microadjustments in their analysis videos they study celebrities and influencers to decode what actually makes people magnetic 7 physical presence and vocal tonality matter stand up straight but relaxed take up space without being aggressive make eye contact but dont stare touch appropriately when theres rapport arm shoulder brief contact these are all ways of communicating confidence and comfort your voice also carries massive weight speak from your chest not your throat slow down pause for emphasis a deeper slower voice is perceived as more attractive and authoritative theres actual research on this from uclas vocal perception studies 8 create experiences not just conversations instead of standard coffee dates or endless texting do something mini golf cooking together exploring a new part of town shared experiences create stronger bonds than interview style conversations theres psychological research on this called the misattribution of arousal when people experience excitement or adrenaline with you they partially attribute those feelings to you its why first date advice always includes active or novel experiences 9 be outcome independent this is the hardest one stop caring so much about specific results you cant control whether someone likes you back but you can control showing up as your best self when you detach from outcomes paradoxically you get better results because youre not radiating desperation practicing mindfulness helps here the insight timer app has thousands of free meditations including ones specifically for social anxiety and building confidence better than any subscription meditation app honestly 10 develop yourself power struggle caught between factions who see him as either weapon or savior zo must navigate a galaxy on the brink of collapse and choose whether to rewrite the fate of the universeor let it return to the chaos from which it was born overview star keep the ark is a cosmic scifi epic that blends ancient mysticism with futuristic intrigue at its heart its the story of zo aku a reluctant hero who learns that he is both the lock and the key to an ancient artifact known as the fulcrum the fulcrum can stabilizeor destroythe delicate balance of the ark stream a network of energy that ties together worlds memories and the souls of entire civilizations as zo journeys through a universe where temples grow from jungle floors and priests weave reality from soulshards he encounters allies and enemies the warriordiplomat tali shanku the enigmatic high priestess sylvi and the shadowy figure sentent who seeks to awaken ancient gods each step brings zo closer to uncovering the secrets of his own past lives and the true nature of the ark themes tone the story weaves themes of identity memory and the balance between creation and destruction it combines a mystical almost spiritual tone with highstakes scifi adventure creating a world where the cosmic and the intimate collide why it stands out star keep the ark offers a unique blend of ancient wisdom and futuristic storytelling its a tale that will appeal to fans of epic space operas and characterdriven narratives alike with its richly imagined universe and deep emotional stakes it invites readers to explore not just the stars but the soul zo aku id cast someone who can convey both vulnerability and strengthsomeone like timothe chalamet he has that introspective quality and the ability to carry a complex soulful role tali shanku for tali id choose someone like zendaya she brings both charisma and a strong presence perfect for a warriordiplomat who can be both fierce and compassionate high priestess sylvi i imagine someone with a timeless ethereal qualitylike tilda swinton shes fantastic at embodying otherworldly characters and would make the high priestess feel truly mystical sentent for the shadowy and enigmatic figure of sentent id go with someone like mads mikkelsen he can bring a magnetic yet unsettling aura perfect for a character who blurs the lines between antagonist and something more profound commander rhea id pick someone like charlize theron she can portray a tough seasoned commander whos both a warrior and a strategist adding depth to the role general zodin for the fierce olc general id cast someone like idris elba he has the commanding presence and gravitas to make zodin a formidable and memorable adversary

stop fearing the blank page the radical power of being undefined right now for anyone here who feels an intense pressure to have a perfectly articulated identitya career a passion a purpose that fits neatly onto a linkedin profilethis reflection is for you we often treat the state of being undefined as a failure state if we arent clearly x y or z society implies we are lost lazy or simply not trying hard enough we chase quick definitions just to quiet the anxiety of that blank space but i want us to radically reframe this state being undefined is not a deficit it is the ultimate starting point of freedom the freedom of the undefined when we are undefined we are unrestricted a definition is a boundary while boundaries are necessary later premature definition is a cage if you define yourself today based on your current anxiety your current debt or your current relationship status you lock yourself out of the incredible person you are capable of becoming next month or next year being undefined means you are standing in a field of pure potential your soul is saying i havent decided yet and thats powerful this is the single greatest moment for healing and expansion because you are unburdened by past expectations or selfimposed labels practical steps to thrive in the ambiguity how do we honor this undefined state instead of panicking through it the key is to shift from seeking outcomes to focusing on process 1 embrace the microexperiment mindset stop trying to find the one thing instead commit to shortterm lowstakes experiments spend 30 days learning a new skill volunteer for a weekend read five books on a topic completely unrelated to your perceived career path do this without the pressure of it becoming your new permanent definition you are simply gathering data on what sparks energy and what drains it 2 identify the must not dos often the clearest definition we can get when we are lost is knowing what we arent list 3 things you absolutely know you need to stop doing stop accepting or stop tolerating in your life eg selfcriticism poor boundaries draining relationships defining what you are not is just as powerful as defining what you are this clears the terrain for new definitions to emerge naturally 3 adopt an interim identity stop trying to define the destination and define the journey instead if you feel undefined label yourself based on the action you are taking you are not lost you are the seeker you are not directionless you are the explorer you are not uncommitted you are the student this shift gives your daytoday actions meaning and moves you out of the victim narrative and into an active role the definition will emerge from the action not the anxiety be kind to yourself in this sacred undefined space it is where all great things begin

space exploration is the physical investigation of outer space by uncrewed robotic space probes and through human spaceflight while the observation of objects in space known as astronomy predates
